name: wolvenkit-q003-inspector
description: Return a read-only metadata report for Cyberpunk 2077 q003 quest resources and safely manage local WolvenKit scripts.

interface.longDescription: Run a read-only WolvenKit report over three q003 quest resources, including node metadata, fact operations, sockets, connections, and scene-exit traces. Also offers guarded local WScript editing tools.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use WolvenKit Q003 Inspector to read the latest q003 metadata report or safely edit local WolvenKit WScript automation.
